metadata.document_title: The Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

article.title: Levy of fee.
article.content: Wherever a copy of any order or document is to be provided to any person on an application made by him for that purpose, there shall be paid such fee as may be prescribed.
article.html:
163Levy of fee.

Section 163 · Chapter XXI · page 120 of the Act

Wherever a copy of any order or document is to be provided to any person on an application made by him for that purpose, there shall be paid such fee as may be prescribed.
